newsitem.title: INDIA: India IOC says no change in diesel buying.
newsitem.headline: India IOC says no change in diesel buying.

text.p: State-run Indian Oil Corporation (IOC) said on Tuesday that there was no change in its approach to purchasing diesel in international markets.

"Since the policy (of the government) has not changed, our approach has not changed," chairman R.K. Narang told a news conference in New Delhi in response to a question on whether IOC was seeking more long-term contracts.
Earlier, trading sources had told Reuters in Singapore that IOC was seeking more long-term contracts so that it could tighten control over import flows and payments.
IOC is India's largest oil refining firm and is listed among Fortune 500 companies.
